stopping: Fixed sample counts; no significance-dependent stopping, condition replacement or sample expansion.
validation_rule: Validation never retunes selection or predictor. Run the preselected conditions even when validation contradicts calibration; report prediction failures.
scope: All models retain common q=.7 network comparisons. A second q is added only when the fixed calibration rule selects a different value. No calibrated condition is invented if none qualifies.
waiting_policy: Qwen7/30 begin on available endpoints. Qwen14 waits for the existing Mistral campaign to restore it. This new fixed campaign characterizes the three original Qwen endpoints and does not require another service rotation. The existing cross-family Mistral study continues under its frozen design.
